description:
Close the epic with deterministic cross-package acceptance coverage, documentation, and a real TUI smoke after all implementation slices land.

## Purpose

Individual children own their unit/regression tests. This issue proves the integrated operator and parent-model behavior as one product without inventing another runtime or duplicating implementation logic.

## Deterministic acceptance scenario

Extend the existing in-process minions/Beadwork harness rather than creating a second harness. With fake child sessions and no paid model:

1. Discover bundled `worker` and `investigate` without user files; prove a project override wins.
2. Start Beadwork goal mode and launch two implementation children using canonical `agent: "worker"` plus taskType/domain metadata.
3. Observe registration as pending/starting, then confirmed running after child handles exist.
4. Parent continues manager-only orchestration and does not edit delegated ticket scope.
5. Human fleet component receives meaningful tool/waiting/settling activity snapshots; no `turn N` overwrite.
6. A child asks the parent; child remains live/waiting, parent answers, settlement waits for accepted mail.
7. Implementation children return atomic commit SHAs; parent starts reviewers only after implementers settle and reviewers inspect named commits.
8. Near-simultaneous final child settlements produce one follow-up lifecycle packet with a bounded snapshot and one group-idle adjudication boundary.
9. Settlement/group idle does not close tickets or claim goal success; scripted parent applies review policy and mutates Beadwork state.
10. All-rejected orchestrate registration creates no empty group and renders rejection truthfully.
11. Start failure after registration becomes failed without unhandled rejection.
12. Foreground spawn remains blocking, uses canonical agent/defaults, and never appears in orchestrated group packets.

Log each step with timestamp, child/group/issue ids, registration and terminal state, activity phase, packet count/seq, and issue status. On failure dump the last fleet snapshot, packets, active tools, prompt appendix, and relevant Beadwork issue state. Keep logging in the test harness, not production telemetry.

## Documentation

Update `packages/pi-minions/README.md` and any relevant root/package operator docs to describe:

- canonical `agent` selector and removal of `role`
- built-in worker/investigate behavior and override precedence
- registration vs liveness vs settlement
- persistent fleet widget and `/minions` drill-down
- sidecar boundary, manager-only Beadwork mode, and group-idle-as-adjudication semantics
- migration note for callers using `orchestrate.role`

Keep `docs/proposals/agent-friendly-improvements-reco.md` as historical recommendation; implementation docs are authoritative after release.

## Manual TUI smoke

In a real persistent Pi TUI:

- launch at least two children, including one orchestrated `worker`
- confirm widget appears without `/minions`, does not capture input, updates useful activity, handles narrow width, and clears at idle
- confirm `/minions` drill-down still works
- confirm the final model-visible packet says group idle/adjudicate, not completed
- switch theme or otherwise invalidate rendering and verify no stale colors/overflow

Record the smoke result in the issue comment/handoff; do not build browser/TUI automation solely for this check.

## Quality gates

Run clean:
- `npm run lint`
- `npm run test`
- `npm run typecheck`
- `npm run build`

No residual warnings without justified ignores. Commit docs/tests atomically with this issue id, close implementation children only after their exact acceptance behavior passes, then close the epic.
title: Prove and publish the agent-friendly orchestration vertical slice
